```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(openrouteservice)
library(sf)
library(httr)


# 1. change to the new API website
options(
  openrouteservice.url = "https://api.heigit.org/openrouteservice"
)

message(
  "Current API website：",
  getOption("openrouteservice.url")
)


# 2. network setting
options(timeout = 60)

# 3. Key package

api_keys <- c(
  "XXX",
  "XXX"
  #, can add more
)

current_key_idx <- 1  # start from the first key
checkpoint_file <- "maternal_sensitivity_checkpoint.rds" # history file

# 4. read history file
if (file.exists(checkpoint_file)) {
  saved_data <- readRDS(checkpoint_file)
  message(paste("already read", length(saved_data)))
} else {
  saved_data <- list()
}

total_rows <- nrow(maternal_sensitivity)

# 5. get isochornes for each point

for (i in 1:total_rows) {
  
  current_id <- as.character(i)
  
  # if the point has been processed, just skip
  if (current_id %in% names(saved_data) && !is.null(saved_data[[current_id]])) {
    next
  }
  
  lon <- maternal_sensitivity$lon[i]
  lat <- maternal_sensitivity$lat[i]
  if (is.na(lon) || is.na(lat)) next
  
  success <- FALSE
  
  # time limit
  Sys.sleep(4)
  
  # if fail, check if there is other key
  while (!success && current_key_idx <= length(api_keys)) {
    
    active_token <- api_keys[current_key_idx]
    
    res <- tryCatch({
      ors_isochrones(
        locations = list(c(lon, lat)),
        profile = "driving-car",
        range_type = "time",
        range = 7200, # change here for hospitals with different thresholds, 30/60/120 mins
        units = "seconds",
        output = "sf",
        api_key = active_token
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      err_msg <- e$message
      message(paste("point", i, "use Key", current_key_idx, "fail:", err_msg))
      
      # switch key, if words "403 / Quota / Rate limit" return
      if (str_detect(err_msg, "403") || str_detect(err_msg, "Quota") || str_detect(err_msg, "rate limit")) {
        message(paste("Key", current_key_idx, "is out of quota, switch to next key"))
        # key + 1
        current_key_idx <<- current_key_idx + 1
      } else {
        # other problem, cease project and check
        return(NULL)
      }
      return(NULL)
    })
    
    # if success
    if (!is.null(res)) {
      success <- TRUE
      
      # merge attributes
      point_attr <- as.data.frame(maternal_sensitivity[i, ])
      point_sf <- bind_cols(res, point_attr)
      
      saved_data[[current_id]] <- point_sf
      saveRDS(saved_data, checkpoint_file)
      
      message(paste0("success[Key ", current_key_idx, "] finish ", i, " / ", total_rows, " points (overall: ", length(saved_data), ")"))
    }
  }
  
  # if key were all used up
  if (current_key_idx > length(api_keys)) {
    message("all keys were used up, project has been ceased")
    break
  }
}


# 6. merge all data
if (length(saved_data) > 0) {
  maternal_sensitivity_final <- do.call(rbind, saved_data)
  message(paste("finish", nrow(maternal_sensitivity_final), "120km isochornes"))
}

# 7. drop list
maternal_sensitivity_final <- maternal_sensitivity_final %>%
  select(where(~ !is.list(.x) | inherits(.x, "sfc")))

# 8. export shp
st_write(maternal_sensitivity_final, 
         dsn = "maternal_sensitivity_final.shp", 
         driver = "ESRI Shapefile",
         layer_options = "ENCODING=UTF-8",
         delete_dsn = TRUE)
```
